name: Request Handling 4
definition: Explains the status of the related request.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Specifies the status of the request, for example the result of the schema validation or a business processing result/error.

StatusReason.name: Status Reason
StatusReason.definition: Provides detailed information on the status reason.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Description of the status, in free format text.

DescriptionRule.definition: If Description is present, then Status/Code is not allowed.
